root_cause.primary: Phase L never loaded the Ingolstadt candidate XODR
details: Phase L validation script (phase_l_validation.py) did not accept an XODR path argument
Phase L never called client.load_world() or client.generate_opendrive_world()
Phase L connected to an already-running CARLA server that had Town10HD_Opt loaded as default
Phase L queried world.get_map() which returned the built-in Town10HD_Opt map
Phase L L2 compared map name against Town10HD_Opt (circular validation)
Phase L had no identity gate to verify the loaded map matched the expected candidate
contributing_factors: The CARLA server was started before Phase L ran, with Town10HD_Opt as the default map
No map-selection call was made in Phase L
The expected_map field in L2 was set to Town10HD_Opt rather than the Ingolstadt candidate
No runtime hash comparison was performed (source hash vs runtime hash)
